scope: Exploratory clarification of frozen two-model selection; aggregate accuracies were already known. No model selection or main outcome decisions are changed.
primary_estimand: Per-model sum of correct observed rollouts divided by sum of observed rollouts, and their paired difference; each bootstrap resamples question clusters with all observed seeds retained.
sensitivities: Equal weighting of questions, using each question's observed rollout mean
Restrict both models to the same questions with all five observed seeds
Worst/best bounds for absent draws among the planned 990 per model
required_checks: Exact current immutable Hub metadata matches all consumed bytes
Pinned original parser used without model or API execution
Every observed row has unique question/seed identity and matches the original per-row retrieval eligibility IDs
Recomputed aggregate totals/correct/unparseable exactly match original behavioral artifact
Shared question prompt and gold hashes match across seeds and models
Report missing IDs and counts; no replacement, retuning or p-value search
interpretation: Descriptive uncertainty for these two preselected models on this benchmark. Question resampling assumes exchangeable benchmark questions; it does not capture benchmark representativeness or selection among candidate models. Not a proof of global capability or a causal capability effect.
